turns.user_utterance: My card just got rejected when I tried to tap it at the checkout! I'm in a rush!
turns.assistant_response: Sorry—looks like your card payment was declined when you tapped at checkout. Can you confirm: was it definitely a contactless tap (not chip/insert), and did the merchant show any specific error (e.g., “insufficient funds” or “try again”)? If you’re comfortable, you can try inserting the card or using another payment method while we check what caused the decline.
